name: AnythingLLM
description: 企业级私人知识库与文档分析工作台，能够将任何文档转为本地 LLM 可理解的上下文。

methods.name: Docker 部署
methods.command: export STORAGE_LOCATION="$HOME/anythingllm_storage" && mkdir -p "$STORAGE_LOCATION" && touch "$STORAGE_LOCATION/.env" && docker run -d -p 3001:3001 --name anythingllm --restart always --cap-add SYS_ADMIN -v "$STORAGE_LOCATION":/app/server/storage -v "$STORAGE_LOCATION/.env":/app/server/.env -e STORAGE_DIR="/app/server/storage" mintplexlabs/anythingllm
uninstall: docker stop anythingllm && docker rm anythingllm

update.command: docker stop anythingllm && docker rm anythingllm && docker pull mintplexlabs/anythingllm && export STORAGE_LOCATION="$HOME/anythingllm_storage" && docker run -d -p 3001:3001 --name anythingllm --restart always --cap-add SYS_ADMIN -v "$STORAGE_LOCATION":/app/server/storage -v "$STORAGE_LOCATION/.env":/app/server/.env -e STORAGE_DIR="/app/server/storage" mintplexlabs/anythingllm

status_check.name: 容器状态
status_check.command: command -v docker >/dev/null 2>&1 && docker ps --filter 'name=anythingllm' --format '{{.Names}} - {{.Status}}' || echo 'AnythingLLM 未运行'

status_check.name: Web 界面
status_check.command: curl -fsS --connect-timeout 2 --max-time 5 http://localhost:3001 >/dev/null && echo 'Web 界面响应正常 (端口 3001)' || echo 'Web 界面未响应'

prompts.setup_knowledge_base: 如何在 AnythingLLM 中导入 PDF 和文档并创建一个可以对话的工作区？
prompts.connect_local_llm: 说明如何将 AnythingLLM 连接到本地运行的 Ollama 模型。

notes: AnythingLLM 默认运行在 3001 端口。数据持久化存储在 ~/anythingllm_storage 目录中。项目主页: https://github.com/Mintplex-Labs/anything-llm
